delta: 'Chapter one closes every lawful road into the pump vault. Vance asked the steward to sign a soak
  slot before the sealing order landed inside the next calving window. Quiej refused, on the ground that
  the co-op will not slot a descent that outlives its own indemnity, and logged the request, which started
  the clock on the indemnity and cost Vance what standing she had. Behind that refusal lies the dive that
  shaped it: one hundred and eighty hours earlier Ilan Vance took a co-op indemnity dive on a four-hour
  cold soak, declined a rig loop his lungs were never certified for and went down on the hard line, crossed
  the vault by count and found the read-key seating two fingers off the co-op''s drawing. The throat cycled
  while he was folding back through it and took his left hand. He signed the indemnity on the deck of
  the lock, with Quiej witnessing, and the co-op took the seating procedure out of him whole. Vance then
  went down without a slot and without a witness and put her hands on the cradle in the dark. She found
  the seating where the drawing does not put it, found the slot in it empty, and found no way to name
  what was missing. She told the wire to trust her. What the chapter spends is her belief that the vault
  can be bought with paper; what it leaves her holding is a shape that only the one man forbidden to name
  it can name.'
words: 252
